gemini-android-side-panel-settings-redes.headline: Google redesigns the side panel and settings in the Gemini app for Android.

oneplus-oxygenos-to-coloros.headline: OnePlus phones move from OxygenOS to ColorOS with the stable Android 17 update.

apple-music-rebrand-2026.headline: Apple Music gets its first rebrand since launching in 2015, with a new logo made from sound.

apple-ios-27-2-selfie-age-verification.headline: iOS 27.2 adds age verification by selfie.

google-gemini-live-plus-menu-redesign.headline: Google redesigns the plus button in Gemini Live on Android to make adding photos and files easier.

google-photos-collections-tab-redesign.headline: Google Photos redesigns its Collections tab so users can customise it.

apple-macos-touch-macbook-pro.headline: Apple brings touch input to the Mac and publishes guidance for adapting apps to it.

chrome-suggested-by-gemini-autofill.headline: Chrome rolls out "Suggested by Gemini" autofill, which fills in more information on web forms.

microsoft-copilot-identity.headline: Microsoft gives Copilot a new identity that positions it as a work tool.

nytimes-175-identity.headline: The New York Times marks its 175th anniversary with a custom 175 mark and identity system.

youtube-google-tv-youtube-music-red-logo.headline: YouTube on Google TV starts showing YouTube Music with a red logo.
